en: Hello {approved_by}, version {version} of the baseline of {project} waits for your approval. The new end is {end}. Reason: {reason}.
mt: 您好,{approved_by}的基线版本 {version} 等待您的批准. 新的结尾是 {end}. 原因: {reason}.

en: Hello {manager}, this week on {name}: {week_start} tasks start and {week_due} are due, and {late_n} are overdue. Next milestone: {next_ms}. Please confirm the owners by Monday noon.
mt: 您好,本周在 {name}: {week_start} 任务开始和 {week_due} 截止,和 {late_n} 延迟. 下一个里程碑: {next_ms}. 请在周一中午之前确认所有者.

en: Hello {sponsor}, we need your decision this week to hold {name} on {date} ({project}). The forecast is {forecast}, with {margin} spare days. Penalty per week late: {penalty_week}.
mt: 你好,我们需要你本周的决定. 预测是 {forecast},有 {margin} 余天. 每周迟到的处罚: {penalty_week}.

en: Hello {who}, we still need {item} for {project} by {needed_by}. We asked on {asked_on}. Please tell us when we will receive it.
mt: 您好,我们仍然需要 {item} 的 {project} 通过 {needed_by}. 我们在 {asked_on}. 请告诉我们什么时候我们会收到它.

en: Hello {contact}, the release {release} is planned for {date}. The code freeze starts on {freeze}. Please confirm the window and who signs off on your side.
mt: 你好,发行 {release} 计划在 {date}. 代码结开始于 {freeze}. 请确认窗口和谁签署在你的边.

en: Hello {contact}, we moved the end of {name} on {project} from {old_end} to {new_end}. The reason is: {reason}. Please tell us if this affects your plans.
mt: 您好,我们把 {name} 的结尾从 {old_end} 移到 {new_end}.原因是: {reason}.请告诉我们,如果这影响您的计划.

en: Hello {contact}, our next company closure is on {next_closure}. The plan for {name} already skips it. Please tell us about your own closure days.
mt: 您好,我们的下一个公司关闭时间是1号. 计划已经跳过了2号. 请告诉我们您的关闭日.

en: Hello {who}, please confirm the delivery date of {item} for {project}. We need it by {needed_by}.
mt: 您好,请确认 {item} 的交付日期.我们需要它在 {needed_by}.

en: Hello {who}, please confirm your booking dates for {item} on {project}. We asked on {asked_on}. Our owner is {owner}.
mt: 你好,请确认您的预订日期. 我们在3号问. 我们的主人是4号.

en: The schedule skips weekends and company holidays. The next company closure is on {col:projects.next_closure}. A change of a date is entered on the Schedule Changes sheet and approved by the sponsor or the PMO lead.
mt: 时间表跳过周末和公司假日.下一个公司关闭时间是 {col:projects.next_closure}. 改变日期将在 时间表变更 页面上输入,并由赞助商或 PMO 领导批准.
